K01.question: Is the observed incremental compound growth robust to resampling temporally clustered returns from the same finite historical record?
K01.method: Paired stationary bootstrap: each new index continues the prior circular index with probability1-1/L, otherwise restarts uniformly; same index sequence applied to both strategies. Expected block lengths7and30calendar days,4096draws each, seeds20261017+length. Calendar days require six complete4hmarks; unknown/gap is not zero return.
K01.metric: Mean daily log-return difference and implied365dayrelative wealth advantage; percentile2.5/50/97.5, plus descriptive resampled share<=0. Do not call that share a p-value or future-loss probability.
K01.limits: Conditional stationary-dependence approximation. Nonstationarity, prior selection, execution bias and unknown full trial lineage are not corrected. This is NOT a fresh backtest, independent confidence certificate or strategy rerun through synthetic markets.

K02.question: How much unmodeled operational/extra execution cost would consume the observed gross-of-extra-cost surplus?
K02.method: Fixed-ledger accounting overlay only: for each annual path report surplus/12 as historical break-even additional monthly budget and surplus/(2*closed_cycles) as additional per-leg budget when positive. Show hypothetical monthly expenses0,0.25,0.5,1 and extra per-leg costs0,0.01,0.05,0.10 in separate tables, plus an explicit combined formula. Already-modeled fees are not charged twice.
K02.limits: Not a new compounded/resized strategy run, not an expense forecast or affordable guaranteed budget. Negative surplus has no positive budget. Additional fees could alter exits/position sizing; this overlay intentionally keeps the recorded path fixed.

K03.question: Can a published selection-adjusted statistic be reproduced without pretending its unknown inputs are available for Arz?
K03.method: Implement DSR equations from Bailey/LopezdePrado2014 selected methods. Reproduce published treasury-example parameters: T1250,annualSR2.5 converted bysqrt250,trialSRvariance1/500,skew-3,rawkurtosis10,N100. Check approximately0.9004; show fixedN46 and normal-momentN88 examples separately.
K03.Arz_status: NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: complete economic-hypothesis selection history/effective independent trial count and comparable trial-SR distribution have not been established. Never substitute168dependent run rows for168independent trials. Do not calculate a real-capital DSR approval.
